stage: B3 managed backup candidate: Identity/Admin/Web + admin migration 147, control plane disabled
source_digest_tool: scripts/rbac-source-digest.py over the pre-commit B3 working tree

control_plane.BACKUP_CONTROL_ENABLED: absent (defaults to false; admin-api built backup repo only on literal true)
control_plane.note: Control metadata tables exist but no control DB connection, worker, S3 storage or schedule is configured; existing A2 enforcement policy untouched.

migration.method: Repo Runner image (b3-migrate:amd64, Dockerfile.migrate) status-checked via admin service account; remote root TCP is locked (error 3118), so SQL was applied by root through the existing mysql container local socket per the B1 convention, then bookkeeping INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES ('147_create_managed_backups') replicated runner markApplied; runner -ownership admin -status re-verified 147=yes. Admin service account (iamd_admin_*) lacks CREATE on schema_migrations, so it cannot run the writer itself.

web.deploy_method: tarball extracted to staging, hashed assets merged first, index.html replaced last so open pages keep working

rollback.note: Rollback: set compose image back to the previous tag and docker compose up -d --no-deps --no-build --pull never <svc>; control tables may stay. Backup control enablement would prevent rolling Identity back below a build that knows the admin.backups execution point.

scope_unchanged.other_containers: all 21 remaining containers unchanged (uptime/restart continuity verified)
scope_unchanged.production_features: pricing/payment/vendor pilots, A2 enforcement policy, relay safety unchanged; no release tag, no production restore executed

external_pending: private production S3 credentials, TLS, permissions and lifecycle, then host backup-worker install (deploy/backup-worker.service, worker env with real DSNs/age recipient)
runtime grants from migrations/manual/147_backup_runtime_grants.example.sql for the admin control account plus separately provisioned backup_worker/backup_snapshot accounts
production RPO/RTO and interruption window confirmation, actual-size restore timing and consecutive schedule observation
controlled enablement: BACKUP_CONTROL_ENABLED=true first, then policy, only after maintainer acceptance of a manual backup/restore drill
notes: docker.io and GitHub were intermittently unreachable during the build window (TLS timeouts); base images were pre-pulled once the registry recovered, then both service images cross-built with scripts/deploy-update.sh.
Deploy order followed the frozen contract: admin migration 147 first, then Identity, then Admin, then Web; host worker intentionally not installed without production storage.
